description:
`web/src/types/hierarchy.ts` is imported by nothing, and it hardcodes a strategic-level threshold.

## Background

A scan of `web/src` (67 files, resolving `import`, `export from`, dynamic `import()` and `vi.mock`) finds every non-entry module imported except `src/types/hierarchy.ts`. The roots that are not imported by design are `src/main.tsx` (`web/index.html:11`), `src/test/setup.ts` (`vitest.config.ts:9`), `src/vite-env.d.ts` (ambient) and the test files. `hierarchy.ts` imports nothing, and no documentation references it. Its lines 43-45 hardcode strategic as `level <= 2`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `web/src/types/hierarchy.ts` no longer exists.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every module under `web/src` other than the entry points and test files is imported by the application or its tests.

## Notes

No import-graph guard is added.
title: Remove the orphaned web hierarchy module
